description.display_value: Mirrored from PagerDuty: For well WELL-0042(h), the channel TVDHD from source log TIME_RT_WITSML was not being populated into the standardized log TIME_SURFACE. Root cause: the standardization mapping file was uploaded after the channel streamed. Customer: CNE. Impact: the real-time drilling dashboard displayed an empty TVDHD curve for the morning run and the customer could not monitor true vertical depth. Mitigation: the mapping file was uploaded again and the channel was backfilled; no data was lost.
